name: Investor Residence Permit (B Category)

requirement_groups.name: B1 -- investor/shareholder of a foreign-invested company

requirements.blocker_text: Is an investor or shareholder of a foreign-invested company registered in Mongolia.
requirements.fix_path: Register or invest in a foreign-invested Mongolian company.

requirement_groups.name: B2 -- representative/executive managing a foreign-invested entity

requirements.blocker_text: Is a representative or executive managing a foreign-invested entity in Mongolia.

requirement_groups.name: B3 -- head of a representative office of a foreign organization

requirements.blocker_text: Oversees a representative office of a foreign organization in Mongolia.

outcome.duration_length: up to 1 year initially, extendable up to 3 years
outcome.physical_presence_requirement: must obtain a residence permit within 21 days of arrival if staying beyond 90 days

sources.title: Invest Mongolia Agency (Government of Mongolia) -- investor visa categories B1 (investor/shareholder), B2 (representative/executive), B3 (representative-office head); residence permit required within 21 days for stays over 90 days; permit up to 1 year, extendable to 3 years

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Mongolia). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- fully tier-1 sourced to Invest Mongolia Agency, a Government of Mongolia body. NO MINIMUM INVESTMENT THRESHOLD FIGURE was disclosed by the source for any of the three sub-categories -- this is disclosed as a genuine gap rather than estimated or invented, consistent with this dataset's practice elsewhere (compare Botswana's and Chad's investor routes, which had the same gap). This route does NOT lead to a distinct fast-track citizenship-by-investment status -- no citizenship-by-investment program was found for Mongolia in this pass, and none is modeled. pr_after_months/citizenship_after_months are inferred the same way as mn_work_permit.json, from the G/immigrant category's 3-year threshold plus naturalisation's 5-year-on-permanent-residence requirement, not independently confirmed for investor-permit holders.
